## What's new in 1.0

- **VSync fix:** before, VSync was only on with high frame rate, so normal play could tear. VSync is now its own option, on by default: in the launcher under Display, in the in-game Tab menu, or `--no-vsync` to turn it off. The game runs at the same speed either way. With high frame rate on, VSync shows one smooth in-between picture per display refresh; with it off, as many as the PC can draw.
